# bash completion for mnema, generated by `mnema completion bash`.
#
# For this shell, now:
#     source <(mnema completion bash)
# For every shell, once:
#     mnema completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/mnema
#
# It completes verbs, subcommands, option names, and the values of an option whose
# declaration enumerates them. It never runs mnema to answer a Tab.

_mnema_commands() {
  case "$1" in
    '') echo 'init task decision skill memory observe handoff link run status focus resume next-actions guard search show timeline accountability antipatterns exposure export refs diagram rules rules-file skills usage brief recall before-a-write tally corrections key tail witness switch verify mcp repl completion help' ;;
    'task') echo 'create move help' ;;
    'decision') echo 'record move supersede import help' ;;
    'skill') echo 'create move export help' ;;
    'run') echo 'start end help' ;;
    'key') echo 'restore request enroll revoke protect unprotect help' ;;
    'tail') echo 'list prune help' ;;
    'witness') echo 'stamp upgrade' ;;
    'switch') echo 'off on' ;;
    *) echo ;;
  esac
}

_mnema_flags() {
  case "$1" in
    '') echo '-V --version --color --identify -h --help' ;;
    'init') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'task') echo '--scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'task create') echo '--scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'task move') echo '--reason --note --feedback -h --help --which -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'decision') echo '--alternatives --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'decision record') echo '--alternatives --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'decision move') echo '--note -h --help --which -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'decision supersede') echo '--reason -h --help --which -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'decision import') echo '--write --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'skill') echo '--body --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'skill create') echo '--body --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'skill move') echo '--note --reason -h --help --which -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'skill export') echo '--out --description -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'memory') echo '--scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'observe') echo '--topic --text --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'handoff') echo '--scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'link') echo '--rel --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'run') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'run start') echo '--which --goal -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'run end') echo '--which --outcome -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'status') echo '--actor --json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'focus') echo '--actor --json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'resume') echo '--actor --json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'next-actions') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'guard') echo '--actor --reason --note --feedback --which --json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'search') echo '--kind --scope --state --from --to --limit --json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'show') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'timeline') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'accountability') echo '--from --to --who --which --json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'antipatterns') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'exposure') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'export') echo '--from --to --who --which --global -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'refs') echo '--direction --depth --json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'diagram') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'rules') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'rules-file') echo '--host -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'skills') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'usage') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'brief') echo '--hook -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'recall') echo '--hook -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'before-a-write') echo '--host -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'tally') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'corrections') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'key') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'key restore') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'key request') echo '--anchor --key -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'key enroll') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'key revoke') echo '--reason -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'key protect') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'key unprotect') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'tail') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'tail list') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'tail prune') echo '--reason --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'witness') echo '--global --json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'witness stamp') echo '--calendar --global -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'witness upgrade') echo '--blocks --global -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'switch') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'switch off') echo '--reason --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'switch on') echo '--reason --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'verify') echo '--global --workspace --allow-no-record --require --since --json -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'mcp') echo '--project -h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'repl') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    'completion') echo '-h --help -V --version --color --identify' ;;
    *) echo ;;
  esac
}

_mnema_values() {
  case "$1" in
    ':--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'init:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'task:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'task:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'task create:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'task create:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'task move:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'task move:') echo 'submit start block unblock submit_review request_changes approve complete cancel reopen' ;;
    'decision:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'decision:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'decision record:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'decision record:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'decision move:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'decision move:') echo 'accept reject' ;;
    'decision supersede:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'decision import:--scope') echo 'public private' ;;
    'decision import:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'skill:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'skill:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'skill create:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'skill create:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'skill move:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'skill move:') echo 'review adopt reject deprecate' ;;
    'skill export:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'memory:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'memory:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'observe:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'observe:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'handoff:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'handoff:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'link:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'link:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'run:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'run start:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'run end:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'status:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'focus:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'resume:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'next-actions:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'guard:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'guard:') echo 'submit start block unblock submit_review request_changes approve complete cancel reopen' ;;
    'search:--kind') echo 'memory observation decision task skill' ;;
    'search:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'search:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'show:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'timeline:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'accountability:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'antipatterns:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'exposure:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'export:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'refs:--direction') echo 'both out in' ;;
    'refs:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'diagram:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'diagram:') echo 'decision skill task timeline refs' ;;
    'rules:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'rules-file:--host') echo 'vscode cursor' ;;
    'rules-file:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'skills:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'usage:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'brief:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'recall:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'before-a-write:--host') echo 'vscode' ;;
    'before-a-write:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'tally:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'corrections:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key restore:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key request:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key enroll:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key revoke:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key protect:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'key unprotect:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'tail:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'tail list:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'tail prune:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'witness:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'witness stamp:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'witness upgrade:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'switch:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'switch off:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'switch off:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'switch off:') echo 'brief-document recall-document edit-rules-push edit-asks-a-person agent-accepts edit-first-write-gate user-corrections session-tally' ;;
    'switch on:--scope') echo 'public private global' ;;
    'switch on:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'switch on:') echo 'brief-document recall-document edit-rules-push edit-asks-a-person agent-accepts edit-first-write-gate user-corrections session-tally' ;;
    'verify:--require') echo 'chained signed witnessed' ;;
    'verify:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'mcp:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'repl:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'completion:--color') echo 'auto always never' ;;
    'completion:') echo 'bash zsh fish' ;;
    *) echo ;;
  esac
}

_mnema() {
  local cur='' prev='' path='' word='' offered='' i=1
  cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
  if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -gt 0 ]; then
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[$((COMP_CWORD - 1))]}"
  fi
  # `--color=` is three words to bash, so the flag is one further back.
  if [ "$prev" = "=" ] && [ "$COMP_CWORD" -gt 1 ]; then
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[$((COMP_CWORD - 2))]}"
  fi
  # Where on the tree the line already is.
  while [ "$i" -lt "$COMP_CWORD" ]; do
    word="${COMP_WORDS[$i]}"
    i=$((i + 1))
    case "$word" in
      -*) continue ;;
    esac
    case " $(_mnema_commands "$path") " in
      *" $word "*)
        if [ -z "$path" ]; then path="$word"; else path="$path $word"; fi
        ;;
    esac
  done
  # A flag whose values the declaration enumerates answers alone.
  offered="$(_mnema_values "$path:$prev")"
  if [ -z "$offered" ]; then
    offered="$(_mnema_commands "$path") $(_mnema_flags "$path") $(_mnema_values "$path:")"
  fi
  # Filtered here rather than by `compgen -W`, which would EXPAND every word.
  COMPREPLY=()
  for word in $offered; do
    case "$word" in
      "$cur"*) COMPREPLY[${#COMPREPLY[@]}]="$word" ;;
    esac
  done
}

complete -F _mnema mnema
